name: חֲגָבָה
summary: Hagabah gives his name to a family of returning temple servants. Ezra lists this family beside Lebanah’s and separately lists the sons of Hagab in the following verse. The longer name probably has the same animal name as its base.

evidence.note: The sons of Hagabah follow the sons of Lebanah.
The parallel register again places this family after Lebana’s.
Hagab’s family has a separate entry immediately below in Ezra.
